title: dt/2 check of c62's Flow-Lenia ecology from noise, second fresh seed (22): predators 15 persistent splits (generation 3, merge/split 0.63), prey 14.6 vs 21.6 in the dt/2 twin
summary: Same protocol as 20261028T0741-c64-fl-ecology-s-dthalf (c62's world_dt.py, WORLD_P dt 0.1 with the S-claim's noise start, --spf 50 --dt 0.1, 160^2, t=3000), fresh seed 22, with the matched predator-free twin at dt 0.1. Predators 28.6 bodies after t=1000, labkit persistent splits 15, generation 3, merge/split 0.63 (seed 22 at dt 0.2: 8, generation 4, 0.81). Prey 14.6 after t=1000 against 21.6 in the twin (-32%). With seed 21 (14 persistent splits, prey -39%), halving the step keeps every measured feature of the ecology on two seeds, with more persistent predator splits and a lower merge/split than at dt 0.2.
